name: realinsight-connector
description: Use Realinsight commercial real estate data and analytics from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to Realinsight through a local MCP server. The extension opens a browser-based Realinsight login, supports SSO/MFA through the normal Realinsight flow, and exposes read-only schema, entity, record, dashboard, analytic, and workbench tools by default.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check the local Realinsight auth profile and complete any pending browser/device authorization after the user approves it.

tools.name: connect_realinsight
tools.description: Start a browser-based Realinsight login for the local MCP server without requiring the user to use a terminal. By default this waits up to five minutes for browser approval and stores the profile when approval completes.

tools.name: disconnect_realinsight
tools.description: Revoke and remove the local Realinsight auth profile used by the local MCP server.

tools.name: request_realinsight_scopes
tools.description: Start a browser-based Realinsight consent flow for a new or expanded local OAuth scope set. By default this waits up to five minutes for browser approval and stores the profile when approval completes.

tools.name: search_features
tools.description: Find Realinsight feature/entity types that may satisfy a user request.

tools.name: search_fields
tools.description: Find runtime fields across all features or within one feature.

tools.name: get_fields
tools.description: List runtime fields for a feature with pagination.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Find Realinsight entities using generic top-toolbar style search, or by searching one or more explicit CustomerDataSearch fields.

tools.name: get_children
tools.description: Fetch child entities for one or more parent entity ids, with optional filters, sorts, global limit, or per-parent limit.

tools.name: get_latest_children
tools.description: Fetch one latest child entity per parent id using an explicit child date/order field. Use this for latest loan servicing, inspection, operating statement, payment, or rent-roll child records before hydrating the returned child ids.

tools.name: get_records
tools.description: Hydrate one or more Realinsight entity ids with key fields or explicitly requested record fields. Values may include display_value plus expansion hints for dictionary/reference/user/document fields.

tools.name: get_entity_structure
tools.description: Traverse parent, master, child, reference, referenced-by, or periodic relationships for one or more entities and return a compact graph.

tools.name: list_dashboard_pages
tools.description: List dashboard pages available to the authenticated Realinsight user.

tools.name: get_dashboard_page
tools.description: Describe a dashboard page, its analytics, global filters, cache status, and backing reports.

tools.name: get_analytic_data
tools.description: Read cached analytic data, analytic JSON, and base report column metadata for the current user. Use get_analytic_csv for large local-table analysis and extract_analytic_entities for compact entity handoff.

tools.name: get_analytic_csv
tools.description: Read one page of cached analytic rows as CSV. For large analytics, write each csv page to a temp file and continue with next_cursor instead of loading all rows into model context.

tools.name: extract_analytic_entities
tools.description: Extract compact entity refs from cached analytic rows so the agent can hydrate or traverse the underlying population with get_records, get_children, or get_latest_children.

tools.name: list_workbenches
tools.description: List saved workbench lists available to the authenticated user, optionally filtered by workbench code.

tools.name: get_workbench_data
tools.description: Read cached workbench table data and backing report column metadata for the current user. Use get_workbench_csv for large local-table analysis and extract_workbench_entities for compact entity handoff.

tools.name: get_workbench_csv
tools.description: Read one page of cached workbench/list-report rows as CSV. For large workbenches, write each csv page to a temp file and continue with next_cursor instead of loading all rows into model context.

tools.name: extract_workbench_entities
tools.description: Extract compact entity refs from cached workbench/list-report rows so the agent can hydrate or traverse the underlying population with get_records, get_children, or get_latest_children.

base_url.title: Realinsight Base URL
base_url.description: Use https://www.realinsight.cloud/api/v1 for production, or a Realinsight-provided API base URL for pilots.

max_tool_result_bytes.title: Maximum Tool Result Bytes
max_tool_result_bytes.description: Maximum bytes returned by one local MCP tool result.
